Class MetadataViewerDialog

  • java.lang.Object
    • javafx.stage.Window
      • javafx.stage.Stage
        • gui.MetadataViewerDialog
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    javafx.event.EventTarget

    class MetadataViewerDialog
extends javafx.stage.Stage
    Modal dialog for displaying extracted metadata in either a structured tree or flat text format, with optional GPS map visualisation.

      • filterTree

        private void filterTree(java.lang.String query)
        Filters the metadata tree using the specified search query. Matching nodes and their parent branches are retained. The complete tree is restored when the query is empty.
        Parameters:
        query - the search query to apply to metadata names and values

      • buildFilteredSubtree

        private javafx.scene.control.TreeItem<MetadataViewerDialog.MetadataNode> buildFilteredSubtree(javafx.scene.control.TreeItem<MetadataViewerDialog.MetadataNode> current,
                                                                                              java.lang.String query)
        Recursively builds a filtered copy of the metadata tree, retaining nodes that match the query or contain matching descendants. Structural pointer tags are excluded from direct matches.
        Parameters:
        current - the current tree item to evaluate
        query - the lower-case search query
        Returns:
        a filtered subtree, or null if the node and all its descendants do not match

      • traverseToRootName

        private java.lang.String traverseToRootName(javafx.scene.control.TreeItem<MetadataViewerDialog.MetadataNode> item)
        Traverses the tree hierarchy from the specified item to determine the associated root file name.
        Parameters:
        item - the tree item whose associated file name is required
        Returns:
        the associated root file name, or null if it cannot be determined
